encoding: byte strings are lower-case hex; scalars are 64 hex digits big-endian
open_items: § 2.1 / § 19 E2: the K0 KDF variant is NOT applied (the spec's current normative form)
§ 19 H11: Nordic uid byte order not yet fixed; uid here is an arbitrary 8-byte string
V9 (boot decision) and V12 (claim-mode traces) are device-internal and not generated here; when generated they must cover PURGE (§ 10.4a) and NO_RESET_PATTERN (§ 7.10.1)
PURGE (OS2S flag bit 3) is not visible on the wire; V11 carries the client-visible UNCLAIM read view
H->D fragments use the same deterministic split as D->H; any H->D split is legal (§ 3.3)
V11 read_image_frame carries the stored CRC unchanged (rev 3 § 10.2), so it may not match a CRC computed over the read image

V0_primitives.note: CMAC: the four RFC 4493 examples (published MACs: bb1d6929e95937287fa37d129b756746, 070a16b46b4d4144f79bdd9dd04a287c, dfa66747de9ae63030ca32611497c827, 51f0bebf7e3b9d92fc49741779363cfe). CCM: 13-byte nonce, 12-byte tag, incl. zero-length plaintext; computed by pyca/cryptography (OpenSSL); no CAVP file is vendored here. ECDH: generator check and a symmetric agreement; CAVP KAS ECC CDH not vendored.

oversize_refusal.rule: rev 4 § 3.4: a frame longer than max_frame (244) is refused [ff][cmd_lo][fe] before any gate; inside a live session the refusal of a gated opcode is SEALED (see d2h oversize_refusal_0x71), otherwise (no session, or a plaintext-set opcode) it is sent in clear
oversize_refusal.client: either form raises an oversize error at once; neither is ever a success
